extensionDescription.message: Record web interactions and step screenshots, then export a clear workflow document.

caseManagementHint.message: Review, share, and export saved cases

folderManageHint.message: Drag to move; rename in More

folderDragHint.message: Drop onto a folder to move inside it, or onto this heading to return to the root. Up to three levels are supported.

moveFolderHint.message: Choose a new parent for $NAME$. Its subfolders and cases move with it.

errorFolderMoveCycle.message: A folder cannot be moved into itself or its descendants

deleteFolderMessage.message: Delete empty folder “$NAME$”? Its empty subfolders will also be deleted.

createSubfolderHint.message: The folder will be created under “$NAME$”

folderNotEmptyDeleteHint.message: $COUNT$ case(s) remain; this folder cannot be deleted

batchDeleteCasesMessage.message: Delete the selected $COUNT$ case(s)? This action cannot be undone.

batchDeleteCasesMessageWithCounts.message: Delete the selected $COUNT$ case(s)? They hold $STEPS$ step(s) and $SHOTS$ screenshot(s); $DELETABLE$ of those are not referenced by any other case and will be deleted. This action cannot be undone.

deleteCasesFailed.message: Could not delete the selected cases

moveCasesIntoFolder.message: Select cases elsewhere and move them into this folder

errorInvalidFolderName.message: Enter a folder name between 1 and 80 characters

errorFolderNameExists.message: A folder with this name already exists

errorFolderDepthLimit.message: Folders support up to three levels

errorFolderNotEmpty.message: $COUNT$ case(s) remain in this folder. Move or delete them first.

recordCasesInSidePanel.message: Record and save a case from the side panel first

openConsole.message: Open the case workbench in a new tab

clearStepsMessage.message: This will delete every step in the current workspace and screenshots not referenced by a saved case, without automatically saving. Saved cases will not be affected, and recording will not start. This action cannot be undone. Continue?

deleteSelectedStepsMessage.message: Delete the selected $COUNT$ step(s)? This action cannot be undone.

deleteStepsFailed.message: Could not delete the selected steps

importCasePackageHint.message: Import a .swrcase package with recorded steps and screenshots into Uncategorized. ZIP files exported as documents cannot be imported as cases.

exportDocumentsHint.message: Export selected cases as a ZIP containing Markdown documents and screenshots for reading or use with AI. This export cannot be re-imported as cases.

exportCasePackageHint.message: Package selected cases as a .swrcase file with recorded steps, screenshots, and case relationships. Others can import it into this extension.

moveCasesHint.message: Move the selected cases to a folder.

deleteCasesHint.message: Delete the selected cases. This cannot be undone after confirmation.

casePackageImported.message: Imported $COUNT$ case(s); view them in case management or relationships

exportCasePackageFailed.message: Could not export the case package

errorInvalidCasePackage.message: This is not a valid Workflow Recorder case package

errorUnsupportedCasePackage.message: This case package version is not supported

errorCasePackageTooLarge.message: This case package is too large to import

emptyStepsPopup.message: Click Start recording and interact with a browser tab to generate operation steps automatically.

emptyStepsConsole.message:
Click Start recording and interact with a browser tab.
Steps will appear here in real time.

errorInvalidCaseName.message: Enter a case name between 1 and 120 characters

saveCaseHint.message: Saved cases are listed in the workspace.

exportSaveCaseHint.message: Downloading also saves this recording as a case; you can find all cases in the workspace.

exportAlreadySavedHint.message: This recording is already saved as a case, so the download will not save it again; all cases are in the workspace.

captureSettingsMessage.message: Step screenshots are the most expensive part of a recording. What you choose here affects screenshots only, never the recorded steps.

captureScreenshotsHint.message: With this off the extension never attaches the debugger and never captures a frame: the lightest mode, and Chrome shows no "debugging this browser" banner.

captureSettingsFootnote.message: Screenshots are always saved at the tab's current native resolution, unscaled. Memory grows with the number of steps and barely at all with how long a recording runs. Changes apply when you next start or continue recording, without changing a recording in progress.

captureSettingsSaved.message: Recording settings saved. They apply to the next recording.

copyTaskHint.message: Click “Copy task for AI” to copy the current case pages, recorded steps, and control context as Markdown. Paste it into your preferred AI tool to analyze the workflow or generate automation scripts. Screenshots are not copied; download the recording if you need them.

previewHint.message: ←/→ to switch, scroll to zoom, drag to pan

missingScreenshot.message: The screenshot is missing or has been cleaned up

captureStateRecaptureFailed.message: Re-capture failed, still showing the previous screenshot

domContextSummary.message: DOM context: $COUNT$ levels (view in document preview)

expandDomContext.message: Click to expand or collapse DOM context

confirmContinue.message: Are you sure you want to continue?

saveBeforeOpen.message: Save the current recording before opening “$NAME$”?

deleteCaseMessage.message: Delete case “$NAME$”? This action cannot be undone.

deleteCaseMessageWithCounts.message: Delete case “$NAME$”? It holds $STEPS$ step(s) and $SHOTS$ screenshot(s); $DELETABLE$ of those are not referenced by any other case and will be deleted. This action cannot be undone.

newCaseConfirm.message: A new case will save the current steps and clear the workspace. Continue?

stopRecordingFailed.message: Failed to stop the current recording

saveRecordingFailed.message: Failed to save the current recording

startRecordingFailed.message: Unable to start recording. Open a regular web page (not chrome://) and try again.

manualScreenshotTitle.message: Update the after-action screenshot for the last operation on the current page, without changing its before-action screenshot

manualScreenshotFailed.message: Failed to update the after-action screenshot

errorScreenshotBusy.message: A screenshot is already in progress

errorManualScreenshotPending.message: Manual screenshot request is being processed

errorPageNotRecording.message: This page is not being recorded

errorNoStepForScreenshot.message: No step on this page can receive a screenshot

errorScreenshotInterrupted.message: The capture was interrupted by a background restart. Use Update after-action screenshot to take it again.

errorScreenshotPageClosed.message: The recorded page was closed before the screenshot could be taken

captureReasonCaptureFailed.message: Could not read the page frame

captureReasonOpensChildPage.message: The click opened a new page

errorNoCapturePage.message: No recorded page is available for capture

errorNoClickPage.message: The clicked page was not found

errorNoRecordingPage.message: No web page is available to record. Open the extension from the target tab and try again.

errorNoStepsToSave.message: There are no steps to save

consentIntro.message: While recording, the extension stores the following on this device:

consentItemUrls.message: URLs and titles of the recorded pages

consentItemActions.message: Clicks, typing, selections, key presses, hovers, and drags

consentItemElements.message: Element tags, ARIA semantics, and limited DOM context for each target

consentLocalOnly.message: This data stays in extension storage on this device. It is never sent to the developer or any third-party server. Do not record sensitive content you do not want kept.

errorCaseSchemaUnsupported.message: This case was saved by an incompatible earlier version and cannot be loaded. Delete it and record again.

errorCaseChangeWhileRecording.message: Cases cannot be changed while recording

errorCaseStoreUpgradeIncomplete.message: The case store upgrade has not finished, so cases cannot be modified yet. Saved cases can still be viewed and exported. Restart the browser and try again.

errorCaseStoreNewer.message: These cases were saved by a newer version of the extension and cannot be modified by this one. Update the extension and try again.

messageTimeout.message: The extension timed out. Please try again.

screenshotCleanupDeferred.message: Completed. Screenshot cleanup will be retried in the background.

errorBranchStepOutOfRange.message: The fork step is out of range for this case

exportCaseReadFailed.message: These cases could not be read and were left out of the export: $NAMES$

continueRecordingReady.message: The case is loaded. Continue recording in the target page's side panel.

selectTargetPage.message: Select a page to continue recording

selectTargetPageHint.message: Choose the page where you want to open the side panel and continue recording.

targetPageUnavailable.message: The target page was closed or cannot be recorded. Choose another page.
